data.prompt:
Create ONE beautiful finished-game UI art direction mockup for the Chinese PC sect management game 青云宗, 16:9 landscape 2K. This is a CONCEPT of the complete V0.8 game, NOT the existing two-building sample. Use the supplied screenshot ONLY for the architectural material palette and natural integration: semi-realistic stylized Chinese architecture, blue-grey roof tiles, warm weathered wood, cream plaster, low grey limestone foundations, sage-green pines, soft upper-left sunlight with right-down shadows. Redesign the entire composition as a WIDE zoomed-out orthographic 2.5D playable sect campus with ALL eight distinct sites visible at once, linked by believable narrow limestone paths and gentle continuous garden terrain. No photo realism, no flat boardgame base, no huge repetitive stone plaza, no golden palaces, no fantasy neon.

WORLD COMPOSITION: main hall 主殿 at upper center, dominant but only about 20 percent of world width; the other SEVEN functional precincts occupy distinct non-overlapping areas around it. 1 弟子居 mid-left, modest residential compound with two matching low wings; 2 伐木场 far left lower, timber workshop with neatly stacked logs by pine grove; 3 采灵坊 far right upper, modest mine entrance integrated into rock and small sorting shed, restrained pale mineral glints; 4 灵田 lower-left, rectangular cultivated grain terraces and small blue-roof farm shed; 5 演武场 lower-center, clearly bounded training courtyard with wooden practice dummies and equipment racks; 6 炼器坊 lower-right, compact forge workshop with modest chimney, charcoal and warm subtle furnace interior; 7 藏经阁 upper-left of the main hall, elegant two-storey library, smaller than main hall. EXACTLY these eight named sites, no extra functional buildings, no new gameplay systems. Every entrance visible, roofs separated, uniform scale and sun direction. Misted mountains and quiet waterfall in upper distant background, low contrast. Small restrained pond at right edge, no noisy flower carpet. Scene should feel like a complete settled sect, each site easily found, not two huge buildings. Avoid adding crowds or promises of character animations.

INTEGRATED UI: this must look like a clear usable desktop game screen, not a poster. Full scene occupies about 80 percent width. Thin dark-jade top resource bar with readable Chinese labels 青云宗 / 木材 / 灵石 / 灵谷 / 弟子 and restrained example numbers. Upper-right small buttons 保存 and 设置. Bottom nav contains five large readable Chinese buttons 宗门, 建设, 弟子, 养成, 挂机. Right side a slim parchment and dark-jade management panel occupying about 18 percent of screen, selected site 弟子居, compact lines 等级, 容量, 建设状态 and actions 升级 / 管理弟子. Include small secondary panel function chips 招募, 岗位分配, 修炼突破, 装备锻造, 挂机战斗 so preservation of the original functions is immediately visible. A compact battle status footer may say 队伍 3/3 and 自动战斗; no new quest systems or currencies. Place small consistent cream-and-dark-jade nameplates directly near each of the eight sites, using the exact Chinese names above. UI restrained, clean spacing, legible cream text, no massive borders, no decorative clutter, world remains the focal point. All visible numbers are illustrative, not design changes.

Mandatory small clear visible caption at bottom right: 完整宗门·目标样式图（非实机）. Do not display any sample/debug buttons or candidate numbers from the reference. No side-by-side panels, no technical diagrams, no fake desktop window. A single polished complete-game screen suitable for the owner to review the final visual direction. Make architecture, grass, paths and contact shadows feel like one scene with equal fine-grain material sharpness. Focus on practical readable eight-site layout and retained management functions, not exaggerated cinematic architecture.

data.prompt:
Using the reference ONLY as architectural style and design reference, create ONE production RGBA transparent sprite atlas for a 2.5D Chinese sect management game. Exactly FOUR equal columns and TWO equal rows, eight separate cells, no printed grid, no text/UI/labels/numbers. The canvas aspect is 16:9. ALL space outside the eight objects must be TRUE transparent alpha, not white, no checkerboard. Keep objects fully inside their respective cells with generous empty padding, no touching neighbors. Same orthographic elevated three-quarter camera, upper-left daylight, blue-grey roof tiles, warm timber, cream plaster, grey low stone plinths, fine semi-realistic stylized game rendering.
TOP ROW LEFT TO RIGHT: (1) the large main hall from the upper center of the reference, complete roof, walls, foundation and front stairs; (2) the two-storey scripture library from upper-left, full building and front steps; (3) a compact residence compound of two small matching residential wings with short connecting wall, as reference middle-left; (4) the lumber yard, one rustic log shed plus neat log piles and short workbench, no surrounding forest.
BOTTOM ROW LEFT TO RIGHT: (5) spirit mine, compact rocky mine entrance with timber support and small sorting shed, a few restrained blue mineral clusters, no giant cliff or terrain; (6) grain farm, neat golden-green grain rows on a small irregular earth planting bed with a tiny low shed, no water wheel; (7) the training court, low grey rectangular paving footprint with wood practice dummies, racks and low fence, no surrounding landscape; (8) forge workshop with blue-grey roof, warm small furnace and a chimney, no huge smoke, include complete low foundation.
Each cell is one grouped functional object with its full silhouette. Transparent outside footprint. No massive square tile/slab under any building, no surrounding trees or mountains or waterfalls, no external ground shadow haze. Match the quiet believable materials and proportions of the supplied concept so all eight belong to ONE game. Objects face generally toward front of image, same scale language, do not stylize as miniature toys or chibi. All architecture normal proportions. This is an atlas of independent buildings/precinct objects, NOT a complete scene. No names, calligraphy, plaques or UI.
